The '''PT-7 starfighter''', also known as the '''Raven starfighter'''<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref> or '''Raven bomber''',<ref name="TOR:SF" /> was a model of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] in use by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. The fighter, which was grayish-white in [[Color/Legends|color]] with blue and yellow markings, had two wings that ended in [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] extending from two engines attached to the side of the rear of the fuselage, and a third engine sat atop the fuselage with two smaller weapon-tipped fins extending diagonally upwards. The pilot was situated in a cockpit at the front of the fuselage, and bombs could be attached to the bottom of the craft. Around [[3643 BBY]] they were used in the [[Independent Operation Sebaddon]].

==Behind the scenes==
The PT-7 starfighter was first mentioned in the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]'', and the novel ''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]'' added the "Raven" designation. The ship then appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. However, the Digital Expansion ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'' introduced the [[FT-series]] of starfighters by Rendili StarDrive that are all variations of the PT-7, suggesting the fighter's proper name to be the FT-7 Raven, or that the FT abbreviation is a mistake, since the Empire's own strikefighter is also using the same FT abbreviation.
